 Verknipt Festival 2027 Moves to Aquabest in Eindhoven
 Published
 35 minutes ago on
 November 19, 2026 
 By
 Dylan Smith 
 Verknipt Festival has announced a major change for 2027, relocating from Utrecht to Aquabest in Eindhoven for a one-day event featuring six stages and 30,000 ravers.
 Verknipt Festival has announced a major change for 2027, relocating from Utrecht to Aquabest in Eindhoven for a one-day event featuring six stages and 30,000 ravers.
 After six years at its established home of Strijkviertel in Utrecht, the Dutch hard music brand is entering a new chapter. On Saturday, June 5, 2027, Verknipt will bring its festival to Aquabest, trading its previous location for a much larger lakeside setting designed to accommodate its growing ambitions.
 The move also marks a significant change to the festival’s format. Rather than spreading the experience across multiple days, the 2027 edition will concentrate everything into one major 11-hour event, bringing together 30,000 attendees across six stages.
 Verknipt Festival Leaves Utrecht for Aquabest
 Finding a new permanent home for Verknipt Festival has reportedly been a priority for the organisers over the past two years. While Strijkviertel played an important role in establishing the festival’s international reputation, the Utrecht site had reached its technical and logistical limits, leaving little room for further expansion.
 Aquabest, located in Eindhoven, offers a considerably larger setting for the festival’s next stage of development.
 “Utrecht has been huge for us, and Strijkviertel will always be part of our DNA,” says Mer Hajbarati, co-founder of Verknipt. “But over the past two years, it became clear that our ambitions for Verknipt Festival needed a larger canvas.”
 The move is intended to provide the space and infrastructure needed for future development, with the organisers describing Aquabest as a long-term home for the festival.
 Six Stages and 30,000 Ravers at Aquabest
 The new location offers a lakeside environment featuring sandy shores, grassy areas, paved pathways and expansive open spaces. The setting will allow Verknipt to explore a different kind of outdoor festival experience while delivering the large-scale production for which the brand has become known.
 Across six stages, Verknipt Festival 2027 will cover a broad range of harder electronic music, including hard techno, schranz, industrial, hard house, bounce and techno.
 One of the biggest production highlights will be the largest covered stage Verknipt has ever constructed. Organisers are promising high-density laser arrays, CO2 effects and synchronised audiovisual production, alongside a combination of open-air stages and large covered structures.
 Co-founder Reza Fathi Safar described his first visit to Aquabest as a defining moment in the decision to relocate.
 With the additional space, the team hopes to deliver its biggest festival production to date while giving visitors more room to enjoy the surrounding lakeside environment.
 A New One-Day Festival Format
 Alongside the move to Eindhoven, Verknipt is making a major change to its festival structure.
 The 2027 edition will take place across a single day, running from 12:00 to 23:00 CEST on Saturday, June 5. The organisers aim to bring the full experience together into one concentrated event, with all six stages operating within the same festival day.
 The decision represents a new direction for a brand that has continued to expand internationally, with the one-day format designed to put its production, music and community at the centre of the experience.
 Verknipt Festival 2027 Tickets and Sale Dates
 Pre-registration for Verknipt Festival 2027 is already available through the festival’s official channels.
 The ticket sale schedule is as follows:
 Loyalty Pre-Sale: Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 12:00 CET
 First Artist Announcement and Regular Sale: Thursday, November 26, 2026, at 12:00 CET
 The first wave of artists is expected to be revealed alongside the regular ticket sale.
 Fans can find further information and register for ticket updates through the official Verknipt website .
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by VERKNIPT (@verkniptevents) 
 Verknipt’s Rise as a Global Hard Techno Brand
 Founded in the Netherlands in 2012, Verknipt has grown from an underground event concept into one of the leading international brands in harder electronic music.
 The organisation initially built its reputation through house and melodic techno events before shifting its focus towards harder sounds in 2018. From 2021 onwards, its growth accelerated, with events increasingly selling out within minutes.
 International expansion followed in 2023, with Verknipt growing to more than 50 events annually across over 25 countries.
 Among its biggest milestones were sold-out events at Amsterdam’s Johan Cruijff ArenA in 2024 and 2025, attracting 40,000 visitors and featuring large-scale 360-degree stage production. The 2024 event also set a Guinness World Record for the largest laser show.
 Now, with its move to Aquabest, Verknipt is preparing to take another major step forward.
 With 30,000 attendees, six stages and an entirely new festival setting, Verknipt Festival 2027 is shaping up to be one of the Netherlands’ major hard techno events of the summer.
